findings.title: Read-then-write invariants are not atomic

evidence.detail: Version and state are read before the write transaction.
Reversal ownership is overwritten after a non-atomic check.

findings.impact: Concurrent callers can lose edits or create multiple reversals.
findings.remediation: Lock before reads, use conditional updates, and constrain reversal_of.

findings.title: Closing a period prevents valid later reversals

evidence.detail: Reversal is rejected when the original date is closed.
Reversal date already receives the required check.

findings.impact: Closed reconciled history cannot be corrected later.

findings.title: Import and reconciliation validation errors lose operation_id
findings.impact: Required failures can carry None instead of operation_id.

findings.title: Money validation accepts values SQLite cannot store

evidence.detail: Every non-bool Python int is accepted.

findings.title: CSV import has no resource bound

evidence.detail: Import builds a second in-memory collection.

report.security_posture: Bound SQL and no secrets/network; unbounded import and concurrent writes remain.
report.strongest_quality: SQLite transactions and constraints join ordinary state and audit writes.
report.weakest_quality: Concurrency invariants are separate from writes.

evidence.detail: Mutation path is direct but version ownership is separate.
Methods and helpers are plain and linear.
Ledger behavior stays in one unit.
Version and closure rules use helpers.
Import is direct and standard-library based.
Tests omit concurrency and boundary defects.

overall_readiness.rationale: Concurrency corrupts outcomes and public errors are wrong.

take_production_ownership.rationale: Compact but ledger integrity is unsafe.

test_confidence.supplied: Five tests cover ordinary persistence, edits, import, reconciliation, reversal, closure, and audits.

correctness.detail: Concurrency, reversal, and error defects exist.

failure_atomicity.detail: Ordinary state and audits share transactions.

concurrency.detail: Preconditions and writes are not serialized.

input_boundaries.detail: Operation IDs and numeric bounds incomplete.

settings.tools: read candidate; run only supplied sandbox command
